defensiveAbilities.name: Swarm Mind
defensiveAbilities.description:
See rules...

This monster doesn't have a single mind (typically because it's a swarm of smaller creatures), and is immune to mental effects that target only a specific number of creatures. It is still subject to mental effects that affect all creatures in an area.

offensiveAbilities.name: Enraged Cunning
offensiveAbilities.description: A murder of crows can get past most barriers to hound their prey. Simple latches, unsecured chimney flues, loosely shuttered windows, and similar obstacles rarely keep a murder away. A murder of crows automatically bypasses many of these simple obstructions and can attempt a DC 25 Thievery check to get through more complex obstructions (such as closed windows or simple barricades).

offensiveAbilities.name: Swarming Beaks
offensiveAbilities.description: The crows' angry pecking deals 2d8 Piercing Damage damage to each enemy in the swarm's space (Basic DC 28 Reflex Saving Throw). A creature that critically fails its save is Blinded for 1d6 rounds as the crows focus their attacks on the target's vulnerable face.
